```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stat870/fall2026/refs/heads/main/data/hens.csv") |> 
  mutate(hen =as.factor(hen))
head(df)

df |> 
  ggplot(aes(age, bw))+
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(hen)))+
  labs(color= "Hen ID", y ="Body weight (lb)")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1,3.5))+
  theme_classic()
```

$$y_{ij} \sim N(\mu_{ij}, \sigma^2), \\ \mu_{ij} = 
\beta_0 + hen_j + f(x_{ij}).$$



```{r}
m <- gam(bw ~ 1 + hen + s(age, bs = "tp", k = 13), data = df)
gam.check(m)
```


```{r}
df_pred <- expand.grid(age = min(df$age):max(df$age), 
                       hen= unique(df$hen))
df_pred$yhat <- predict(m, newdata = df_pred)
```



```{r}

df |> 
  ggplot(aes(age, bw))+
  geom_line(aes(color = factor(hen), y = yhat), data = df_pred)+
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(hen)))+
  labs(color= "Hen ID")+
  theme_classic()

```

```{r}
plot(emtrends(m, ~age, "age", at =list(hen= factor(1), 
                                  age =175:190)))
```



```{r}
m2 <- gam(adg ~ 1 + hen + s(age, bs = "tp", k = 13), data = df)
gam.check(m2)

plot(emmeans(m2, ~ age, at =list(hen= factor(1), 
                                  age =175:190)))
```











When = $f'(x) = 0$



```{r}
df_pred <- expand.grid(age = seq(175, 185, by = .1), 
                       hen= factor(1))
df_pred$yhat <- predict(m, newdata = df_pred)

df_pred <- df_pred |> 
  mutate(y_diff = (yhat - lag(yhat))/.1) |> 
  filter(y_diff<0)

df_pred |> 
  ggplot(aes(age, y_diff))+
  geom_line()
```


```{r}
df_pred |> 
  filter(y_diff == -min(abs(df_pred$y_diff), na.rm = T))
```

```{r}
df_pred |> 
  ggplot(aes(age, y_diff))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = (df_pred |> 
                             filter(y_diff == -min(abs(df_pred$y_diff), 
                                                   na.rm = T)))$age)
```



## Uncertianty quantification  

What is the uncertainty behind the value of x where $f'(x)$ becomes negative? 

```{r}
m <- gam(bw ~ 1 + hen + s(age, bs = "tp", k = 13), data = df)

df_pred <- expand.grid(age = seq(175, 185, by = .1), 
                       hen= factor(1))
df_pred$yhat <- predict(m, newdata = df_pred)

df_pred <- df_pred |> 
  mutate(y_diff = (yhat - lag(yhat))/.1) |> 
  filter(y_diff<0)

(df_pred |> filter(y_diff == -min(abs(df_pred$y_diff), na.rm = T)))$age
```

```{r}
# setting up
B <- 1000
n <- nrow(df)
age_min_boot <- numeric(B)

set.seed(42) # Set seed for reproducibility

for (i in 1:B){
  df_boot <- df[sample(1:n, replace = T),]
  
  m_boot <- gam(bw ~ 1 + hen + s(age, bs = "tp", k = 13), data = df_boot)
  
  df_pred_boot <- expand.grid(age = seq(175, 185, by = .1),
                              hen= factor(1))
  df_pred_boot$yhat <- predict(m_boot, newdata = df_pred_boot)
  
  df_pred_boot <- df_pred_boot |>
    mutate(y_diff = (yhat - lag(yhat))/.1) |>
    filter(y_diff<0)
  
  age_min_boot[i] <- 
    (df_pred_boot |> 
       filter(y_diff == -min(abs(df_pred_boot$y_diff), na.rm = T)))$age
  
}

```

```{r}
hist(age_min_boot, breaks = 25)
```









```{r}
B <- 500
n <- nrow(df)
age_min_boot <- numeric(B)

set.seed(42) # Set seed for reproducibility

for (i in 1:B) {
  # obtain resampled data
  df_boot <- df[sample(n, replace = TRUE), ]
  
  # fit the model again, but with the resampled data
  m_boot <- gam(bw ~ 1 + hen + s(age, bs = "tp", k = 13), data = df_boot)
  
  #do everything again
  df_pred_boot <- expand.grid(age = seq(175, 185, by = .1), 
                              hen = factor(1))
  df_pred_boot$yhat <- predict(m_boot, newdata = df_pred_boot)
  
  df_pred_boot <- df_pred_boot |> 
    mutate(y_diff = (yhat - lag(yhat)) / .1) |> 
    filter(y_diff < 0)
  
  res <- df_pred_boot |> filter(y_diff == -min(abs(df_pred_boot$y_diff), na.rm = TRUE))
  age_min_boot[i] <- if(nrow(res) > 0) res$age[1] else NA
}

ci <- quantile(age_min_boot, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
```

```{r}
df_pred <- expand.grid(age = min(df$age):max(df$age), 
                       hen= unique(df$hen))
df_pred$yhat <- predict(m, newdata = df_pred)



df |> 
  ggplot(aes(age, bw))+
annotate("rect", xmin = ci[1], xmax = ci[2], 
         ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
         fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.15) +  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(age_min_boot))+
  geom_line(aes(color = factor(hen), y = yhat), data = df_pred)+
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(hen)))+
  labs(color= "Hen ID")+
  theme_classic()
```
